lines.text: The LORD calls out to the city and tells them to heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
The LORD asks whether He can forget the short ephah and excuse dishonest scales and bags of false weights.
The priests of the city are full of violence, so the LORD is striking them severely to ruin them.
The people will eat but not be satisfied, and they will tread grapes but not drink the milk.
The city kept the statutes of Omri and followed their counsel, so it will bear the scorn of the nations.
